# opnsense_interfaces_neighbor (Resource)

Static ARP/NDP entries (Interfaces > Neighbors).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Pin the printer's MAC to its address.
resource "opnsense_interfaces_neighbor" "printer" {
  mac_address = "00:11:22:33:44:55"
  ip_address  = "192.168.10.30"
  description = "Office printer"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip_address` (String) IPv4 or IPv6 address.
- `mac_address` (String) Hardware address, e.g. `00:11:22:33:44:55`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to `""`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the entry.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID
terraform import opnsense_interfaces_neighbor.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
